reason: 要旨は「Vision-language-action models (VLAs) often achieve high performance on demonstrated tasks but struggle significantly when required to extrapolate, recombining skills used in different tasks in novel ways. For instance, VLAs might successfully put the cream cheese in the bowl and put the bowl on top of the cabinet, yet still」を扱い、対象契約のLLM inference/serving効率・推論時圧縮への寄与を示していない。
title: VLAs Are Confined yet Capable of Generalizing to Novel Tasks
